THE PLAYGROUND

Welcome to the Playground.

The fourth room of the school, beside the Library, the School Garden and the Music Room: the action words our bodies do here, the things standing on the ground and the five manners that make play kind — the word tiles open their own flashcard pages, and the games shelf at the foot of the room holds twelve playground classics with their full rules.

THE ACTION WORDS

Fifteen words our bodies do at the playground.

Balance on the bench edge, catch the big ball, dig to the middle of the earth, run everywhere: every action word gets its own card, and every card is a game the body already wants to play. Tap any word to open its own step-by-step lesson — what it means, how the body does it and how to practise tonight.

BalanceCatchClimbDigHideJumpKickPlayPullPushRunSitSlideSwingWalk
ON THE GROUND

Twelve things you meet at the playground.

The ball that never says no, the slide that waits at the top, the sandbox with a square of beach inside it: the playground’s own furniture, one card and one lesson each. Name the place before you go and the trip gets a whole vocabulary louder.

BallBenchClimbing FrameFenceLadderMonkey BarsSandboxSeesawPlayground SlideSpring RiderPlayground SwingTunnel
HOW WE PLAY TOGETHER

Five manners that make the playground kind.

Help, share, stop, take turns, wait — the five words that turn a playground full of wanters into a playground full of friends. Each card has its own lesson: the word, the words to say and one way to practise it before you even get there.

HelpShareStopTake TurnsWait
GAMES WE PLAY HERE

Twelve games this playground was built for.

The circle forms for Duck Duck Goose, the chalk slab becomes a hopscotch court, and the open grass is a Red Light Green Light lane the moment somebody shouts green. Each card opens its rules page on the school’s games shelf — the steps in order, the things to gather and a brand-new way to run the game tomorrow. The other twenty-three games, from Balloon Keep-Up to Treasure Hunt, wait on the games shelf too.

Duck Duck GooseTagRed Light, Green LightHopscotchFour SquareFollow the LeaderObstacle CourseTunnel CrawlSack RaceThree-Legged RaceRelay RaceBubble Chase
PRINT & PLAY

Take the whole playground home.

All thirty-two cards live in the Playground flashcard set — every card page has a download button with the full-size image. The Playground sits in School Rooms beside the Library, the School Garden and the Music Room.

FLASHCARDS

Prefer printed cards?

The cards from this class also live in the flashcards library — every card has its own page with the picture, the words to say together and a download button, ready for away-from-screen time.
